description: process_create in submission.rs calls identities[0] (line 734) and emails[0] (line 762) after an is_empty() early-return guard. Idiomatic Rust has .first() specifically for this pattern. The current form panics if the vec somehow becomes empty between the guard and the access (impossible here, but the compiler cannot prove it). Use identities.into_iter().next() or .first().expect("just checked non-empty") to signal intent and satisfy clippy::get_first.
title: submission.rs: vec[0] after is_empty guard should use .first()
